title: How to display both HP and MP gauges at SV enemies battlers

posts.author: Sussuri
posts.body:
Hi there,
I would like to find some way to display MP gauge under HP gauge, same as it is done with HP gauge. I'm using YEP_X_VisualHpGauge, but there is no option to display mana as well. For the gauges in the middle table I'm using VCM_EnemyGauges. It's important for me to show amount of enemy mana, but with VCM plugin it's not possible to use some other plugins like YEP_X_SelectionControl for example.
Do you know about some solution how to display mana gauge under HP gauge?
Thanks.
S.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Sussuri said:
with VCM plugin it's not possible to use some other plugins like YEP_X_SelectionControl for example.
Click to expand...
Why isn't it possible? Why not ask for help fixing that?

posts.author: Sussuri
posts.body:
ATT_Turan said:
Why isn't it possible? Why not ask for help fixing that?
Click to expand...
SelectionControl will remove that mid table so you can also pick as a targets your own ally. So in other words, there is no space for that table which is main feature of VCM if I understand that correctly.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Just for clarity, the word is "window" not "table".
If you provided a link to the plugin you're asking about, someone could take a look - it's very unlikely both plugins are actually trying to use the same window, all one should need to do is change the position of the window in one of the plugins.
